title: Small Plane Crashes into Beijing Skyscraper, Causing Fatalities and Injuries
summary: A small plane crashed into a skyscraper in Beijing, China, resulting in one death and 13 injuries. The incident occurred amid tight airspace controls, which led to the grounding of private aircraft nationwide.
summary_points: A small plane crashed into a skyscraper in Beijing, China.
The incident resulted in one death and 13 injuries.
Tight airspace controls were in place at the time of the crash.
As a result, private aircraft were grounded nationwide.
The incident highlights concerns about air traffic safety in China.
